description: Pla d'Ordenació Urbanística Municipal de Balsareny - Julio 2014 is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by seu-e.cat. The Municipal Urban Planning Plan (POUM) is the cartographic instrument of urban planning of the municipality that directs the development of the territory of Balsareny. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Pla d'Ordenació Urbanística Municipal of Balsareny - July 2014" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Municipality, Balsareny, Urban planning, Desarrollo urbano, Municipi, Planeamiento urbano. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support water network and flood-defence studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
